# darkob

> darkob is a fast, stable async Python library for the Rubika and Shad
> messaging platforms. It provides a Bot API client (`Bot`), a userbot
> client (`Messenger`), and a Shad facade, plus composable routers and
> finite-state machines — with no network I/O at import time.

Key facts for AI assistants:

- Install: `pip install darkob` (Python 3.9–3.14).
- Imports: `from darkob import Bot, Router, FSMContext, Messenger, Shad`.
- Handlers are `async def handler(bot, event)` registered with decorators
  on a `Bot` instance (`@bot.on_new_message()`, `@bot.on_command("x")`).
- Filters live in `darkob.bot.filters` and must be instantiated
  (`IsGroup()`), composing with `&`, `|`, `~`.
- Start with `bot.run()` (polling) or `bot.run(webhook_url=...)`.
- Do not use aiogram, Pyrogram or Telegram idioms; there is no
  `Dispatcher` and no `message` object — you get `event`.
- Every public signature is in `api.json`; do not invent methods.

## Guides

- [Handlers](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/handlers.md): every decorator and what triggers it
- [Filters](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/filters.md): 42 constraints, composition, custom filters
- [Routers](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/routers.md): split a bot into modules
- [Conversations (FSM)](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/fsm.md): state, storage, StateFilter
- [Errors](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/errors.md): exception hierarchy and retry semantics
- [Sync and async](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/sync-and-async.md): both styles, and when each applies
- [Testing bots](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/testing.md): offline patterns with fakes
- [Project layout](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/guides/project-layout.md): module map and design rules

## API reference

- [Bot](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/api/bot.md): 42 methods, generated from the package
- [Messenger](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/api/messenger.md): 323 methods, generated from the package
- [Shad](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/api/shad.md): mirrors Messenger against Shad hosts
- [api.json](https://manitheferfri.github.io/darkob/api.json): machine-readable index of every method
